assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.text: So we need to think of some questions for this survey about the weather,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.zh: 所以我们得想一些关于天气调查的问题，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.text: Murat.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.zh: 穆拉特。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.text: Should we make a list of them?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.zh: 我们要不要列一个问题清单？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.text: I think we should decide what we want to find out.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.zh: 我觉得应该先决定我们想了解什么。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.text: Professor Hadland told us we should look at all the different things we could survey,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.zh: 哈德兰教授告诉我们，应该看看所有可以调查的内容，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.text: group them and then try to choose the most important ones.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.zh: 把它们分类，再试着挑出最重要的内容。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.text: Right.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.zh: 对。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.text: Effects of weather on mood.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.zh: 天气对情绪的影响。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.text: Well,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.zh: 嗯，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.text: we're looking at weather in Northern Europe where it is often cold and wet.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.zh: 我们研究的是北欧的天气，那里经常又冷又湿。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.text: Generally in Northern Europe people see sunshine as positive,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.zh: 一般来说，北欧人把阳光看作积极因素，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.text: which I find strange.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.zh: 这让我觉得很奇怪。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.text: In my country,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.zh: 在我的国家，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.text: it's hot all the time.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.zh: 天气一直很热。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.text: So we like cool days.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.zh: 所以我们喜欢凉爽的日子。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.text: But anyway,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.zh: 不过话说回来，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.text: I read some research about weather and moods in Sweden.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.zh: 我读过一些关于瑞典天气和情绪的研究。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.text: I really enjoyed reading it, but it had so many different answers.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.zh: 我很喜欢读那项研究，不过它给出了很多不同的答案。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.text: It wasn't clear that weather changes people's mood.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.zh: 天气是否会改变人的情绪并不明确。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.text: Oh,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.zh: 哦，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.text: great.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.zh: 太好了。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.text: But they did find some specific results.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.zh: 不过他们确实发现了一些具体结果。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.text: They noticed that good dry sunny weather didn't make people happier.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.zh: 他们注意到，干燥晴朗的好天气并不会让人更快乐。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.text: But bad weather made people more upset if they were already unhappy.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.zh: 但如果人本来就不开心，坏天气会让他们更烦躁。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.text: And?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.zh: 然后呢？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.text: And therefore unhappy people felt even worse when it was wet and windy.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.zh: 因此，不开心的人在又湿又有风时会感觉更糟。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.text: Oh, OK.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.zh: 哦，明白了。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.text: So for the good weather category,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.zh: 所以在好天气这一类中，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.text: no
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.zh: 没有

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.text: link.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.zh: 关联。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.text: But for the bad weather part,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.zh: 但对于坏天气，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.text: it causes unhappy people to feel worse.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.zh: 它会让不开心的人感觉更糟。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.text: Yes.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.zh: 有。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.text: And the amount of sunlight seems to be linked to feeling tired.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.zh: 日照量似乎也与疲劳感有关。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.text: When it is sunny,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.zh: 天气晴朗时，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.text: people have more energy and are less tired.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.zh: 人们精力更充沛，也没那么累。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.text: So they like doing more things outside.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.zh: 因此他们更愿意在户外做事。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.text: OK,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.zh: 好的，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.text: I've added that.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_92ec18f58de32a8.zh: 我已经记下来了。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.text: Also, I read something about humid weather.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.zh: 另外，我还读到一些关于潮湿天气的内容。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.text: Another experiment showed that really humid weather changes how people work.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.zh: 另一项实验表明，非常潮湿的天气会改变人的工作方式。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.text: When it is humid,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.zh: 天气潮湿时，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.text: they might plan to study at a different time,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.zh: 他们可能会计划换个时间学习，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.text: or maybe they might stop studying and take a break when they begin having difficulties.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.zh: 或者一遇到困难就停止学习、休息一下。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.text: As a result,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.zh: 结果，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.text: it is more difficult to work and it's hard to pay attention.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.zh: 工作会更困难，也很难集中注意力。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.text: And there was something about heat and anger.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.zh: 还有一些关于炎热和愤怒的内容。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.text: Really hot weather can make people angrier, I think.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.zh: 我觉得非常炎热的天气会让人更容易生气。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.text: Are you sure?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.zh: 你确定吗？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.text: Should I add it?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.zh: 我该加进去吗？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.text: Well, write it down anyway.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.zh: 不管怎样，先写下来吧。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.text: OK.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.zh: 好。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.text: Which area do you think we should look at then?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.zh: 那么你觉得我们该研究哪一方面？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.text: I think the humid one is important,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.zh: 我觉得潮湿天气这一项很重要，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.text: especially for students.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.zh: 尤其对学生来说。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.text: But the one on bad weather making people feel worse could be interesting too.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.zh: 不过，坏天气让人感觉更糟这一项也可能很有意思。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.text: It sounds like there are more useful facts with that topic.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.zh: 听起来这个主题有更多有用的事实。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.text: Yes, true.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.zh: 是的，没错。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.text: I'm not sure about the really hot weather and being angry.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.zh: 我不太确定特别炎热的天气和愤怒之间的关系。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.text: I can't remember if that's true.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.zh: 我记不清这是否是真的。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.text: So,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.zh: 所以，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.text: let's leave that out.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.zh: 我们先不写这个。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.text: That leaves three possible topics.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.zh: 这样还剩三个可能的主题。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.text: Humid weather stops us working,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.zh: 潮湿天气妨碍我们工作，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.text: sunny weather makes us less tired,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.zh: 晴天让我们没那么累，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.text: or bad weather makes people feel worse.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.zh: 或者坏天气让人感觉更糟。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.text: The one about humid weather looks at how people study.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.zh: 潮湿天气这一项研究的是人怎样学习。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.text: It isn't really about how people feel,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.zh: 它其实不是关于人的感受，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.text: so it isn't useful for us.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.zh: 所以对我们没用。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.text: I'd go with bad weather or sunny weather.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.zh: 我会选坏天气或晴天。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.text: I see what you mean.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.zh: 我明白你的意思。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.text: We could choose either of those.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.zh: 我们可以二选一。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.text: I'm not sure about the bad weather one.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.zh: 我不太确定坏天气那一项。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.text: It's a bit depressing, isn't it?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.zh: 有点让人沮丧，不是吗？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.text: Which do you prefer?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.zh: 你更喜欢哪一个？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.text: I don't really care.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.zh: 我不太在意。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.text: Well, if you don't care,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.zh: 那如果你不在意，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.text: let's do the one about sunshine and having energy.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.zh: 我们就选阳光和精力这一项吧。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.text: It's more positive.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be32c8d04465302.zh: 它更积极。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_30e78f8e0265ebb.text: And so I put all the results into a spreadsheet on my laptop.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_30e78f8e0265ebb.zh: 所以我把所有结果都输入了笔记本电脑上的电子表格。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_30e78f8e0265ebb.text: Here are all the answers from the surveys I did.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_30e78f8e0265ebb.zh: 这是我做的调查得到的所有答案。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_30e78f8e0265ebb.text: Oh, and the three surveys that you did.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_30e78f8e0265ebb.zh: 哦，还有你做的三份调查。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_30e78f8e0265ebb.text: We asked how people felt when they woke up on a sunny day.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_30e78f8e0265ebb.zh: 我们问的是，人们在晴天醒来时感觉如何。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_30e78f8e0265ebb.text: 14 out of 15 people said they feel better in sunny weather than when it is very wet or rainy.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_30e78f8e0265ebb.zh: 15人中有14人说，比起非常潮湿或下雨的天气，他们在晴天感觉更好。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_30e78f8e0265ebb.text: And 13 of them said it made them feel they could get a lot done that day.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_30e78f8e0265ebb.zh: 其中13人说，阳光让他们觉得当天能完成很多事情。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_30e78f8e0265ebb.text: Also, 12 out of 15 people said that they did more when the weather was good.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_30e78f8e0265ebb.zh: 此外，15人中有12人说天气好时他们做得更多。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b9542d21f6245f8.text: What about when they feel most tired?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b9542d21f6245f8.zh: 他们什么时候感觉最累呢？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b9542d21f6245f8.text: everyone said that they felt tired if the weather was cloudy and dark.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b9542d21f6245f8.zh: 每个人都说，天气多云阴暗时会感到疲惫。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b9542d21f6245f8.text: And 14 said they had the most energy when there was lots of light.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b9542d21f6245f8.zh: 其中14人说，光线充足时他们最有精力。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b9542d21f6245f8.text: So good weather means that people have more energy.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b9542d21f6245f8.zh: 所以好天气意味着人们更有精力。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b9542d21f6245f8.text: Yeah, that is what our survey seems to show.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b9542d21f6245f8.zh: 是的，这似乎就是我们的调查结果。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b9542d21f6245f8.text: Of course, it might be different in another country.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b9542d21f6245f8.zh: 当然，另一个国家的情况可能不同。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b9542d21f6245f8.text: Maybe it depends on the place you live.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b9542d21f6245f8.zh: 也许取决于你住在哪里。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.text: Global warming is an important issue around the world.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.zh: 全球变暖是全世界的重要问题。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.text: Recently it has created problems in the western Gatts rainforests of India.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.zh: 最近，它给印度西高止山脉的热带雨林带来了问题。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.text: Forests are important for slowing down global warming because of the work that trees do for us.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.zh: 森林之所以对减缓全球变暖很重要，是因为树木为我们所做的工作。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.text: Trees are global cleaners.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.zh: 树木是全球的清洁工。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.text: They take in carbon dioxide,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.zh: 它们吸收二氧化碳，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.text: CO2,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.zh: 二氧化碳，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.text: the gas that heats the atmosphere.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.zh: 这种使大气升温的气体。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.text: So we keep making global warming worse every time we cut down trees.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.zh: 所以每当我们砍伐树木，都在使全球变暖更加严重。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.text: Then global warming continues to damage the forest.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.zh: 随后，全球变暖继续破坏森林。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.text: More trees disappear because the changes in temperature stop the normal growth of the forest.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.zh: 由于气温变化阻碍了森林的正常生长，更多树木正在消失。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.text: Nowadays rainforests get less rain and this is changing the way they work.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.zh: 如今，热带雨林的降雨减少了，这正在改变它们的运作方式。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.text: Governments around the world are beginning to work on the problem.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.zh: 世界各国政府正开始着手解决这个问题。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.text: Although governments say they will stop people damaging the forests,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.zh: 尽管政府说会阻止人们破坏森林，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.text: scientists don't think the work is happening quickly enough.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.zh: 科学家认为这项工作进展得不够快。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.text: The scientists say the forests are changing.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.zh: 科学家说，森林正在发生变化。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.text: The animals and the plants that animals need are changing.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.zh: 动物以及动物赖以生存的植物都在变化。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.text: In fact,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.zh: 事实上，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.text: scientists believe 45 % of the forest areas are going to change completely in the next 80 years.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.zh: 科学家认为，未来八十年内，45%的森林区域将彻底改变。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.text: This is where the purple frog becomes important.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.zh: 这就是紫蛙变得重要的地方。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.text: A report tells us that the frog is in danger of disappearing forever.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.zh: 一份报告告诉我们，这种青蛙正面临永久消失的危险。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.text: The frog can run very fast,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.zh: 这种青蛙跑得很快，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.text: makes a noise like a small chicken, and is one of the most unusual animals in the world.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.zh: 叫声像小鸡，是世界上最不寻常的动物之一。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.text: Of course,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.zh: 当然，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.text: for some people the end of one type of frog is not important.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.zh: 对有些人来说，一种青蛙的消失并不重要。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.text: But it is for Satyabhama Das Bijou,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.zh: 但对萨蒂亚巴玛·达斯·比朱来说却很重要，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.text: a researcher from Delhi University,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.zh: 他是德里大学的一位研究员，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.text: who discovered it in 2003.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.zh: 他在2003年发现了它。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.text: For him,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.zh: 对他而言，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.text: the problems of the purple frog show what global warming is doing to the Indian rainforests.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.zh: 紫蛙的问题表明全球变暖正在对印度热带雨林造成什么影响。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.text: He explains that this interesting animal won't be around much longer if we don't look after the forests.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8154fcd3c6885b9.zh: 他解释说，如果我们不保护森林，这种有趣的动物很快就会消失。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.text: Nowadays rainforests get less rain and this is changing the way they work.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.zh: 如今，热带雨林的降雨减少了，这正在改变它们的运作方式。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.text: Governments around the world are beginning to work on the problem.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.zh: 世界各国政府正开始着手解决这个问题。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.text: Although governments say they will stop people damaging the forests,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.zh: 尽管政府说会阻止人们破坏森林，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.text: scientists don't think the work is happening quickly enough.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.zh: 科学家认为这项工作进展得不够快。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.text: The scientists say the forests are changing.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.zh: 科学家说，森林正在发生变化。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.text: The animals and the plants that animals need are changing.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.zh: 动物以及动物赖以生存的植物都在变化。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.text: In fact,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.zh: 事实上，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.text: scientists believe 45 % of the forest areas are going to change completely in the next 80 years.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.zh: 科学家认为，未来八十年内，45%的森林区域将彻底改变。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.text: This is where the purple frog becomes important.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.zh: 这就是紫蛙变得重要的地方。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.text: A report tells us that the frog is in danger of disappearing forever.

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.text: The frog can run very fast,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.zh: 这种青蛙跑得很快，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.text: makes a noise like a small chicken, and is one of the most unusual animals in the world.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.zh: 叫声像小鸡，是世界上最不寻常的动物之一。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.text: Of course,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.zh: 当然，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.text: for some people the end of one type of frog is not important.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.zh: 对有些人来说，一种青蛙的消失并不重要。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.text: But it is for Satyabhama Das Bijou,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.zh: 但对萨蒂亚巴玛·达斯·比朱来说却很重要，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.text: a researcher from Delhi University,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.zh: 他是德里大学的一位研究员，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.text: who discovered it in 2003.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.zh: 他在2003年发现了它。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.text: For him,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.zh: 对他而言，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.text: the problems of the purple frog show what global warming is doing to the Indian rainforests.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.zh: 紫蛙的问题表明全球变暖正在对印度热带雨林造成什么影响。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.text: He explains that this interesting animal won't be around much longer if we don't look after the forests.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.zh: 他解释说，如果我们不保护森林，这种有趣的动物很快就会消失。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.text: Bijou is going to present information about the forests next week.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.zh: 比朱下周将介绍这些森林的情况。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.text: He hopes to get people interested in saving this frog and other animals that live in rainforests.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.zh: 他希望让人们关注拯救这种青蛙以及生活在热带雨林中的其他动物。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.text: During the next week,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.zh: 在接下来的一周里，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.text: many people are meeting to talk about the climate and saving the rainforests.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.zh: 许多人将聚在一起讨论气候和保护热带雨林。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.text: According to Bijou,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.zh: 据比朱说，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.text: we need to plan now, or we will probably lose some species completely.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.zh: 我们现在必须制定计划，否则可能会彻底失去一些物种。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.text: If we don't think carefully about the climate of the forests,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.zh: 如果我们不认真考虑森林的气候，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.text: the purple frog possibly won't be around for much longer.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.zh: 紫蛙可能不会再存活太久。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.text: On to the weather report now.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f884d273d9a2176.zh: 现在转到天气预报。
